raw_response: {"diagnosis":"On 2026-01-18 the source began sending reversals as separate REVERSAL rows and stopped updating the original, which stays POSTED. silver_transactions keeps only POSTED rows, so it still counts the 15 reversed originals and gold totals are too high. Before the change, originals were flipped to REVERSED and dropped.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.78,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions x WHERE x.status = 'REVERSAL' AND x.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
